cards.title: Quality Control and Interpretation
cards.claim: MIC values for relevant Quality Control (QC) strains must be within acceptable ranges before reporting clinical isolate results. MIC values are interpreted into susceptibility categories (S, I, R) according to current EUCAST Breakpoint Tables.
conditions: QC strain MICs must be in range.
Use current EUCAST Breakpoint Tables for S/I/R categorization.
limitations: Breakpoints are dynamic; must use current version.
cards.downstream_use: Final step in converting numerical MIC to clinical susceptibility category, which may be used for binary PK/PD analysis.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
